recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a current build-scope example inconsistency while preserving later BR&R decisions and leaving the unresolved terminology proposal to the UTG workflow.
issue_request: FHIR-43561 was an Applied/Persuasive BR&R R6 change request to add ResearchSubject.subjectState with code 1..1, startDate 1..1, endDate 0..1, and reason 0..1.
initial_application: Git commit 2c0399d1c94d627f78c8a68e0acf23676bc8c23d added ResearchSubject.subjectState, removed ResearchSubject.progress from the StructureDefinition, and updated the subject_state search parameter. Follow-up commits corrected startDate cardinality and binding strength, but the checked-in examples still used progress.
additional_context: The BR&R ResearchSubject Resource page states that subjectState and subjectMilestone replace the R5 Progress backbone. FHIR-44837 added subjectMilestone and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-49254 later changed subjectState.code to an example binding; UP-585 remains an unresolved external UTG/THO terminology proposal.
reconciliation: Changed source/researchsubject/researchsubject-example.xml and source/researchsubject/researchsubject-example-crossover-placebo-to-drug.xml so their state and milestone data use the current element names and element order.
source_changes: source/researchsubject/researchsubject-example.xml: replaced three progress entries with one subjectState and two subjectMilestone entries, with dates mapped to startDate/date as appropriate.

source/researchsubject/researchsubject-example-crossover-placebo-to-drug.xml: removed the obsolete progress/type entries and represented the on-study state with subjectState.code, reason, and startDate.

related_jiras.note: Companion Applied issue added subjectMilestone; it is already represented on the combined branch and was used only as context for current example shape.
Applied issue changed ResearchSubject.subjectState.code binding strength from extensible to example, explaining current source differences from earlier implementation commits.
Unresolved UTG/THO proposal for ResearchSubjectState terminology; it remains outside this core-source reconciliation.
